title: BC DAY ITALY II : 7th May 2026
summary: BC DAY ITALY II is a free community event on May 7, 2026 in Milan for Dynamics 365 Business Central users, partners, and customers. The event features technical and functional sessions in Italian language with attendee and sponsor waiting list registration, plus an open call for speaker submissions.
key_points: Free event held in Milan at Microsoft House on May 7, 2026 with Italian language focus
Open to customers, partners, and BC enthusiasts regardless of background
Attendees, speakers, and sponsors must register through waiting list system
Call for speaker submissions for functional, technical, and integration sessions in Italian
Event relies on sponsorships to support the Italian BC community
